description.value:
Orthogenists are wizards who reject the premise that the natural world is a thing to be worked with rather than rewritten. They reach to the living pattern beneath organic life and correct it. This subclass is a thematic foil to druids and nature-aligned characters.

Doctrine: Contain the root. Bring the alien seed. Read the hidden pattern. Command the instinct. Burn the old growth. Dream the better form. Feed life with death. Fix the chosen shape.
